app_fee.value: No application fee for the chemistry PhD.
app_fee.quote: There is no application fee to apply to our PhD program.

gre_general.value: Chemistry does not require GRE scores to apply, including the subject test.
gre_general.quote: The Chemistry Department and the School of Science and Engineering do not require GRE scores in order for you to submit your application for review by the department.

gre_subject.value: Chemistry does not require GRE scores to apply, including the subject test.
gre_subject.quote: The Chemistry Department and the School of Science and Engineering do not require GRE scores in order for you to submit your application for review by the department.

toefl_min.value: Department ESL rule: TOEFL 90 or IELTS 7 (or an English-speaking degree).
toefl_min.quote: ESL Proficiency Requirement: TOEFL - Score 90 OR IELTS - Score 7

ielts_min.value: Department ESL rule: IELTS 7 or TOEFL 90 (or an English-speaking degree).
ielts_min.quote: ESL Proficiency Requirement: TOEFL - Score 90 OR IELTS - Score 7

supervisor.value: Advised to identify at least one faculty member whose research matches theirs before applying.
supervisor.quote: it is helpful to identify at least one faculty member who has a background and research in the area in which you are most interested in studying

funding.value: All admitted graduate students get a teaching assistantship stipend and a tuition waiver.
funding.quote: All graduate students that are admitted are supported with a Teaching Assistantship stipend and are awarded a tuition waiver.

entry_route.value: Applicants must have their bachelor's degree before starting; the admission is revoked otherwise.
entry_route.quote: If you have not graduated with your bachelor's degree, your admission will be revoked

deadline.value: Application deadline January 15, 2027 for Fall 2027 entry (School table).

notes: The chemistry FAQ still shows the Fall 2026 deadline (December 31, 2025); the Fall 2027 date comes from the School table. The FAQ calls a TOEFL or IELTS score recommended, but its ESL requirement line lists TOEFL 90 or IELTS 7; the requirement line is used.
